posts.title: Convert a Byte Array to an Integer in Java
posts.description: In Java there are several ways to convert a byte array into an integer. Let’s assume little endian order for all examples. If you need big endian order you can use can use Integer.reverseBytes. 1. ByteBuffer byte[] byteArray = new byte[] {1, 2, 3, 4}; int intValue = ByteBuffer.allocate(4).put(byteArray).getInt(0); System.out.println(intValue); System.out.println(Integer.toBinaryString(intValue));
